title: Annotation app: tracer must be injected, never a package-level var
answers: How should tracing be wired for new code in the annotation app?
Where do I get a trace.Tracer in pkg/registry/apps/annotation?
Can I add a package-level otel tracer here?
body: In pkg/registry/apps/annotation, every component that starts spans takes a `trace.Tracer` as a constructor or function parameter (e.g. NewAppInstaller, NewDashboardFolderResolver, newInstrumentedStore, newSearchHandler, newTagsHandler, newGraphiteHandler, canAccessAnnotation(s), resolveDashboardFolders). RegisterAppInstaller receives a `tracing.Tracer` from the app server and passes it down. There is no package-level `tracer` variable (pkg/registry/apps/annotation/tracing.go was deleted). New code adding spans in this package must accept a tracer parameter/field rather than reintroducing a package-level otel.Tracer().
applies: pkg/registry/apps/annotation and code that constructs its components
